description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sephiroth, adding {C}{C}.
When Sephiroth dies, Anax triggers, creating two 1/1 Satyr creature tokens.
When the Satyrs enter the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Satyr, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Sephiroth by paying {3} and sacrificing a Satyr, returning Sephiroth from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sephiroth enters, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat.
